title: Universal fixed-scalar derived extension computed on K-flat complexes
statement: For an essentially small site $J$, commutative rings $A,B$ in the module universe and any ring homomorphism $f:A\to B$, the type DerivedExtension of [def-pur-finite-reduction-system] is nonempty: sheafified scalar extension has a universal left-derived functor, and its counit is invertible at every K-flat complex. No flatness, surjectivity or nonzero-ring assumption is made.

source.place: First paragraph: scalar extension on flat models and successive coefficient reductions

proof.text: Use [lem-pur-finite-reduction-restrict-tensor] and the conservative exact restriction functor. The proved CochainComplex.quasiIso_map_of_iso_tensorRight shows that extension carries quasi-isomorphisms between K-flat complexes to quasi-isomorphisms.

source.place: First paragraph: scalar extension on flat models and successive coefficient reductions

proof.text: Apply the K-flat left derivability structure to construct the total left derived functor, its counit, and its universal property. The derivability computation theorem makes the counit invertible at every K-flat complex.
